name: Chiefdom
description: Political system organized around ranked leadership, kinship, tribute, redistribution, and chiefly authority.

name: City-state
description: Urban-centered polity exercising authority over a city and associated territory.

name: Kingdom
description: Polity organized around monarchical sovereignty, succession, court structures, and territorial authority.

name: Empire
description: Multi-territorial political system incorporating or subordinating distinct populations under an imperial structure.

name: Republic
description: Political system in which public authority is institutionally distinct from hereditary personal sovereignty.

name: Democratic system
description: Family of systems structuring collective authorization and participation in public decision-making.

name: Bureaucratic administration
description: Administrative system using specialized offices, records, procedures, delegated authority, and continuity.

name: Federation
description: Political system distributing authority between a central government and constituent polities.

name: Customary law
description: Normative system maintained through established practice, precedent, social memory, recognition, and sanction.

name: Religious law
description: Legal or normative system deriving rules and interpretive authority from religious traditions and institutions.

name: Common-law system
description: Legal tradition substantially structured through judicial decisions, precedent, interpretation, and enacted law.

name: Civil-law system
description: Legal tradition substantially organized through codified statutes and systematic legal doctrine.

name: Restorative justice
description: Justice practices emphasizing repair of harm, affected-party participation, accountability, and restoration.

name: Gift economy
description: Exchange system in which transfers can create obligation, reciprocity, prestige, alliance, or relationship.

name: Tribute system
description: Resource-transfer system in which subordinate persons or communities provide goods, labor, or wealth to dominant authority.

name: Market economy
description: Economic system in which exchange and allocation are substantially coordinated through markets and price signals.

name: Planned economy
description: Economic system in which significant production and allocation decisions are coordinated through deliberate planning institutions.

name: Commons governance
description: Collective resource-management system using rules for access, stewardship, monitoring, sanction, and distribution.

name: Guild system
description: Occupational system organizing membership, training, standards, mutual obligations, market access, and political influence.

name: Kinship system
description: System organizing descent, household membership, marriage, inheritance, obligation, identity, and social relationship.

name: Clan system
description: Social organization based on recognized descent, ancestry, alliance, shared identity, or related obligations.

name: Caste system
description: Hereditary or strongly bounded stratification governing status, occupation, marriage, interaction, and access.

name: Patronage network
description: Relationship system exchanging protection, access, office, resources, or status through personal or factional ties.

name: Mutual-aid system
description: Cooperative system through which participants pool resources, labor, risk, or support for shared benefit.

name: Oral tradition
description: Knowledge-transmission system relying substantially on memory, performance, repetition, apprenticeship, and narrative.

name: Apprenticeship system
description: Learning system transmitting practical knowledge through guided participation under experienced practitioners.

name: University system
description: Institutional system combining advanced teaching, credentialing, knowledge production, preservation, and professional formation.

name: Archive system
description: Preservation and retrieval system organizing records, metadata, custody, access, and historical memory.

name: Scientific peer review
description: Validation and communication mechanism in which research claims are evaluated by knowledgeable peers under defined norms.

name: Temple system
description: Institutional system organizing sacred space, ritual activity, personnel, offerings, resources, and participation.

name: Monastic system
description: Religious institutional system organized around disciplined communal or solitary practice, rules, property, education, and ritual.

name: Levy system
description: Military recruitment system drawing personnel from a population under political, customary, or contractual obligation.

name: Professional army
description: Military system based substantially on continuously organized personnel, training, command, logistics, and institutional service.

name: Mercenary system
description: Military labor system in which armed personnel or units serve primarily through contractual compensation.

name: Fortification network
description: Defensive system linking fortified places through geography, logistics, surveillance, communication, and strategy.

name: Irrigation system
description: Water-control system coordinating physical infrastructure, labor, allocation, maintenance, property, and governance.

name: Road network
description: Infrastructure system connecting places through engineered routes, maintenance, rights, logistics, and movement.

name: Telecommunications system
description: Technical network enabling information transfer through interoperating physical, protocol, organizational, and service components.

name: Supply chain system
description: Interdependent system of production, transport, storage, financing, information, procurement, and distribution.

name: Hospital system
description: Organized health-care system combining facilities, personnel, procedures, resources, records, and patient flows.

name: Public-health system
description: Population-level system for surveillance, prevention, sanitation, health promotion, intervention, and coordination.

name: Forest stewardship system
description: Resource-management system governing access, harvesting, regeneration, protection, and social obligations around forests.

name: Festival system
description: Recurring cultural system coordinating ritual, performance, exchange, identity, scheduling, and communal participation.

name: Organized-crime network
description: Clandestine system coordinating illicit markets, enforcement, finance, information, recruitment, and territorial or relational control.

name: Smuggling network
description: Covert movement system transferring people or goods across regulated boundaries through concealed logistics and intermediaries.

name: Black-market system
description: Exchange system operating outside or against formal legal restrictions, with its own prices, trust mechanisms, risks, and enforcement.

name: Bribery mechanism
description: Corruption mechanism in which value is transferred to influence the exercise of entrusted authority.

name: Nepotism mechanism
description: Preferential allocation mechanism in which kinship improperly influences access to office, resources, or opportunity.

name: Regulatory capture
description: Governance failure in which a regulated interest substantially redirects regulatory institutions toward its own interests.

name: State capture
description: Systemic corruption pattern in which private or factional interests substantially reshape public institutions, rules, or enforcement for their benefit.

name: Embezzlement mechanism
description: Diversion mechanism in which entrusted resources are appropriated contrary to their authorized purpose.

name: Information suppression
description: Mechanism through which relevant information is withheld, distorted, destroyed, or restricted to alter system behavior or accountability.

name: Council governance
description: Collective decision system in which authority is exercised through a council, assembly, or deliberative body.

name: Assembly governance
description: Governance system centered on collective deliberation, attendance, voting, consensus, or public participation.

name: Confederation
description: Association of constituent polities retaining substantial autonomy while coordinating through agreed institutions.

name: Constitutional monarchy
description: Monarchical system constrained and structured by constitutional rules and representative or administrative institutions.

name: Absolute monarchy
description: Monarchical system in which sovereign authority is concentrated in a ruler, subject to historically variable institutional constraints.

name: Theocratic governance
description: Governance system in which religious authority, law, office, or doctrine substantially structures political rule.

name: Military government
description: Governance arrangement in which armed forces or military authorities exercise substantial governmental authority.

name: Colonial administration
description: Administrative system through which an external power governs a dependent territory and its population.

name: Occupation administration
description: Temporary or contested governance system imposed by an occupying power over territory under military control.

name: Stateless governance
description: Governance arrangements operating without a centralized sovereign state, using customary, communal, kinship, or network institutions.

name: City council system
description: Municipal governance system organizing local authority through councils, offices, procedures, and delegated administration.

name: Federal system
description: Constitutional system distributing public authority between national and constituent territorial governments.

name: Unitary state administration
description: Governance system in which ultimate constitutional authority is concentrated at the national level while administration may be decentralized.

name: Electoral system
description: Institutional system translating eligible participation into public offices or representative mandates through defined procedures.

name: Civil service system
description: Professional administrative system organizing public employment, recruitment, hierarchy, duties, and continuity.

name: Tax administration
description: System for assessing, collecting, recording, enforcing, and allocating public revenue.

name: Constitutional law
description: Body and institutional system governing the structure, powers, limits, and relationships of public authority.

name: Criminal justice system
description: System for defining prohibited conduct and investigating, adjudicating, sanctioning, and supervising responses to it.

name: Civil justice system
description: System for resolving disputes among persons or organizations through recognized legal procedures and remedies.

name: Administrative law
description: Rules and institutions governing public administration, delegated authority, procedure, review, and accountability.

name: International law
description: Normative and institutional system governing relations among states and other recognized international actors.

name: Maritime law
description: Legal system governing navigation, shipping, vessels, maritime commerce, and related jurisdiction.

name: Military law
description: Specialized legal system regulating armed forces, service obligations, discipline, offenses, and command.

name: Property law system
description: Rules and institutions defining rights, duties, transfer, possession, use, and control of resources and things.

name: Contract system
description: Rules and institutions governing voluntary agreements, obligations, performance, breach, and remedies.

name: Inheritance system
description: Rules and practices determining transfer of property, status, duties, or offices after death.

name: Restitution system
description: Legal or customary mechanism seeking restoration of improperly taken resources or compensation for loss.

name: Arbitration system
description: Dispute-resolution system in which parties submit conflicts to designated decision-makers outside ordinary court proceedings.

name: Mediation system
description: Dispute-resolution system using a neutral intermediary to facilitate negotiated settlement without imposing a binding judgment.

name: Barter economy
description: Exchange arrangement in which goods or services are directly traded without requiring money as the primary medium.

name: Reciprocity system
description: Resource-exchange system organized around expected return, mutual obligation, relationship, or repeated interaction.

name: Redistributive economy
description: Economic system in which resources are collected by a central or coordinating authority and subsequently allocated.

name: Subsistence economy
description: Economic system primarily organized around direct production or acquisition of resources for household or community consumption.

name: Taxation system
description: Public-revenue system that transfers resources from persons or entities to governing authorities under defined rules.

name: Feudal economy
description: Historically variable agrarian arrangements combining landholding, labor obligations, rents, protection, and layered rights.

name: Mercantilist system
description: Early-modern policy system emphasizing state-directed commerce, strategic trade, accumulation, and regulation.

name: Capitalist economy
description: Economic system characterized by substantial private ownership, market exchange, wage labor, and capital accumulation.

name: Socialist economy
description: Family of economic arrangements emphasizing social or collective ownership and deliberate coordination of production and distribution.

name: Cooperative economy
description: Economic system in which member-owned organizations jointly own, govern, and operate productive or service enterprises.

name: Credit system
description: Institutional system for extending, recording, pricing, securing, and settling obligations over time.

name: Banking system
description: Financial system organizing deposits, lending, payments, liquidity, risk, and related institutions.

name: Monetary system
description: System defining money, issuance, denomination, circulation, settlement, and institutional monetary authority.

name: Insurance system
description: Risk-pooling system transferring defined financial risks among participants through contracts, reserves, and claims processes.

name: Labor market system
description: Institutional and social system coordinating the exchange of labor time and skills for compensation and related rights.

name: Tax-farming system
description: Revenue-collection arrangement in which private or delegated collectors obtain fiscal revenue under contractual or administrative authority.

name: Slave-labor economy
description: Economic system in which coerced unfree labor is systematically incorporated into production, extraction, or service.

name: Informal economy
description: Economic activity occurring partly outside formal registration, taxation, labor regulation, or institutional accounting.

name: Rentier system
description: Economic arrangement in which significant income derives from control of scarce assets, resources, rights, or financial claims.

name: Household system
description: Social and economic unit organizing residence, reproduction, care, consumption, labor, and resource sharing.

name: Lineage system
description: Descent-based system organizing identity, inheritance, obligation, membership, and social continuity.

name: Moiety system
description: Social organization dividing a community into complementary descent or affiliation groups with defined relationships.

name: Age-grade system
description: Social system grouping people by age cohorts with differentiated duties, status, education, or ritual roles.

name: Estate system
description: Stratification system organizing society into legally or customarily distinct ranked estates with differentiated rights and duties.

name: Class system
description: Social stratification system in which socioeconomic position is associated with resources, occupation, power, and life chances.

name: Diaspora network
description: Translocal social system connecting dispersed populations through identity, kinship, exchange, communication, and institutions.

name: Intentional community
description: Community deliberately formed around shared values, practices, governance arrangements, or resource commitments.

name: Fraternal organization
description: Voluntary association organized around membership, mutual support, ritual, identity, or shared institutional purposes.

name: Secret society
description: Restricted-membership association using controlled knowledge, initiation, secrecy, or concealed organization.

name: Mutual insurance society
description: Member-based institution pooling risks and contributions to provide benefits to participants.

name: Volunteer association
description: Voluntary organization coordinating members around shared service, civic, cultural, recreational, or charitable purposes.

name: Scriptorium system
description: Manuscript-production system organizing copying, preservation, annotation, and transmission of written knowledge.

name: Library system
description: Institutional system for acquiring, organizing, preserving, describing, and providing access to recorded knowledge.

name: Academy system
description: Institutional system for advanced learning, scholarly association, research, patronage, and knowledge exchange.

name: School system
description: Organized educational system structuring instruction, curriculum, teachers, learners, assessment, and credentials.

name: Apprentice guild school
description: Occupational education system combining supervised practice, standards, membership, and staged competence.

name: Credentialing system
description: Institutional mechanism for certifying demonstrated education, skill, authority, or professional standing.

name: Standards system
description: System for defining, documenting, testing, and maintaining shared technical or procedural specifications.

name: Classification system
description: Knowledge system that organizes entities or observations into categories according to explicit or implicit criteria.

name: Censorship system
description: Institutional mechanism restricting, removing, labeling, or controlling access to information or expression.

name: Propaganda system
description: Coordinated communication system designed to shape public beliefs, attitudes, identities, or behavior.

name: Intelligence system
description: Organizational system for collecting, evaluating, protecting, analyzing, and disseminating information for decision-making.

name: Patent system
description: Legal and administrative system granting defined exclusive rights in exchange for disclosure of qualifying inventions.

name: Scientific society
description: Scholarly association supporting research communication, standards, meetings, publication, and professional community.

name: Museum system
description: Institutional system for collecting, preserving, interpreting, documenting, and exhibiting material or cultural objects.

name: Shrine system
description: Religious system organized around a sacred place, object, person, event, pilgrimage, offering, or devotional practice.

name: Pilgrimage network
description: Translocal religious system connecting sacred destinations, routes, hospitality, ritual, exchange, and community.

name: Priesthood system
description: Specialized religious role system organizing ritual authority, training, succession, duties, and institutional status.

name: Church system
description: Religious institutional system organizing congregations, clergy, doctrine, ritual, property, education, and governance.

name: Mosque-centered community system
description: Religious community system organized around communal worship, education, charity, social ties, and local institutions.

name: Synagogue-centered community system
description: Religious community system organizing worship, learning, communal governance, charity, and shared identity.

name: Missionary system
description: Institutional network for transmitting religious teachings across geographic or cultural boundaries.

name: Tithing system
description: Resource-transfer system in which members or adherents contribute defined shares or offerings to religious purposes.

name: Ritual system
description: Structured set of repeated symbolic actions, roles, objects, spaces, timings, and meanings.

name: Initiation system
description: Ritual and social mechanism marking transition into a religious community, role, status, or stage of life.

name: Militia system
description: Armed organization drawing personnel from a civilian population under defined local, political, or communal obligations.

name: Conscription system
description: Recruitment system requiring eligible persons to perform defined periods of military service.

name: Naval system
description: Military maritime system integrating vessels, bases, personnel, logistics, command, intelligence, and doctrine.

name: Military logistics system
description: System for supplying personnel and equipment with food, fuel, ammunition, transport, maintenance, and information.

name: Military intelligence system
description: Information system supporting military decisions through collection, analysis, dissemination, and protection.

name: Resistance network
description: Decentralized or organized system through which actors oppose an occupying, coercive, or dominant authority.

name: Insurgency system
description: Conflict system in which organized non-state actors use political, social, and military methods against an established authority.

name: Occupation system
description: Military-political system governing territory and population under foreign or external armed control.

name: Mercenary company
description: Contract-based military organization supplying armed personnel or capabilities to paying clients.

name: Fortress system
description: Defensive system centered on fortified positions, garrisons, logistics, surveillance, and controlled access.

name: Writing system
description: Symbolic technology for encoding, storing, transmitting, and retrieving language or other structured information.

name: Numeral system
description: Representational system for expressing quantities, arithmetic operations, and numerical relationships.

name: Calendar system
description: Timekeeping system defining recurring units, cycles, dates, seasons, and synchronization conventions.

name: Measurement system
description: Standards and practices for representing physical quantities using defined units, instruments, and procedures.

name: Irrigation canal network
description: Engineered water-distribution network connecting sources, channels, controls, fields, maintenance, and allocation rules.

name: Sewerage system
description: Infrastructure and institutional system for collecting, transporting, treating, and disposing of wastewater.

name: Water-supply system
description: Infrastructure system for sourcing, treating, storing, distributing, and governing potable or usable water.

name: Electrical grid
description: Interconnected system for generating, transmitting, distributing, balancing, and regulating electrical power.

name: Railway system
description: Transport infrastructure system linking tracks, stations, vehicles, signaling, scheduling, maintenance, and operations.

name: Port system
description: Maritime infrastructure and institutional system organizing vessels, cargo, navigation, customs, labor, and logistics.

name: Postal system
description: Communication and logistics system for collecting, sorting, transporting, and delivering physical messages and parcels.

name: Internet
description: Global interoperable network system based on packet-switched communication, addressing, routing, protocols, and autonomous networks.

name: Domain-name system
description: Hierarchical naming system translating human-readable domain names into network-addressing and service records.

name: Computer operating system
description: Software system managing hardware resources, processes, files, devices, security, and application interfaces.

name: Blockchain system
description: Distributed ledger architecture coordinating replicated state, transaction ordering, validation, and programmable or rule-bound ownership records.

name: Medical licensing system
description: Regulatory system defining qualifications, authorization, scope of practice, discipline, and professional accountability in medicine.

name: Medical education system
description: Educational system preparing practitioners through instruction, supervised practice, assessment, and credentialing.

name: Quarantine system
description: Public-health control system restricting movement or contact to reduce transmission of specified hazards.

name: Sanitation system
description: Population-level infrastructure and practices for managing human waste, contamination, hygiene, and environmental health.

name: Pharmaceutical system
description: System connecting drug discovery, development, manufacturing, regulation, distribution, prescribing, and use.

name: Health insurance system
description: Financial and institutional system pooling health risks and paying or reimbursing defined health services.

name: Emergency medical system
description: Rapid-response health system coordinating dispatch, prehospital care, transport, emergency facilities, and handoff.

name: Traditional healing system
description: Culturally embedded system of healing knowledge, practitioners, materials, rituals, diagnosis, and care practices.

name: Water-rights system
description: Rules and institutions governing access, allocation, use, transfer, priority, and conflict over water.

name: Pastoral system
description: Livelihood and resource-management system organized around mobile or semi-mobile livestock production and grazing.

name: Fisheries management system
description: Resource-governance system regulating access, harvest, seasons, gear, monitoring, and conservation in fisheries.

name: Hunting-territory system
description: Resource-access system defining hunting areas, rights, seasons, obligations, and stewardship practices.

name: Land-tenure system
description: Institutional arrangement defining rights and obligations concerning land possession, use, inheritance, transfer, and access.

name: Mining system
description: Extraction system connecting geological resources, property rights, labor, technology, finance, transport, regulation, and environmental effects.

name: Waste-management system
description: System for collection, transport, processing, disposal, reuse, recycling, and governance of discarded materials.

name: Conservation system
description: Institutional and ecological management system aimed at maintaining specified species, habitats, resources, or ecosystem functions.

name: Language community
description: Social system organized around shared language practices, transmission, identity, norms, and communication.

name: Oral performance system
description: Cultural transmission system using performed narrative, song, poetry, recitation, memory, and audience interaction.

name: Theater system
description: Institutional and social system organizing performance, venues, performers, production, audiences, financing, and repertoire.

name: Music institution
description: System organizing musical production, training, performance, preservation, patronage, and transmission.

name: Publishing system
description: Production and distribution system for transforming authored material into reproducible public or private publications.

name: Media system
description: Communication system connecting content production, distribution, audiences, financing, technology, and regulation.

name: Sports organization system
description: Institutional system organizing competition, rules, clubs, leagues, officials, training, venues, and audiences.

name: Craft tradition
description: Knowledge and production system transmitting skilled making practices, standards, materials, tools, and cultural meanings.

name: Festival calendar system
description: Cultural scheduling system organizing recurring communal events, ritual timing, performance, exchange, and collective identity.

name: Piracy network
description: Illicit maritime system involving unauthorized seizure, transport, exchange, concealment, and organization at sea.

name: Protection racket
description: Coercive illicit system extracting recurring payments in exchange for claimed protection or non-interference.

name: Trafficking network
description: Criminal network organizing prohibited movement or exploitation of persons or controlled goods through intermediaries.

name: Counterfeit economy
description: Illicit production and exchange system based on unauthorized imitation of goods, currency, documents, or marks.

name: Prison economy
description: Resource-exchange system emerging within or around incarceration, involving formal restrictions and informal markets or obligations.

name: Tax-evasion network
description: Coordinated system for concealing taxable activity, assets, income, or transactions from authorities.

name: Clandestine finance network
description: Concealed financial system used to move, store, obscure, or transfer funds outside ordinary oversight.

name: Nepotism
description: Preferential allocation of office, contracts, resources, or opportunity based substantially on kinship rather than stated criteria.

name: Cronyism
description: Preferential allocation of public or organizational benefits through personal, political, or factional relationships.

name: Embezzlement
description: Unauthorized appropriation or diversion of entrusted resources by a person or organization controlling them.

name: Fraud mechanism
description: Deceptive system behavior that induces another party to transfer resources, rights, or authority.

name: Extortion mechanism
description: Coercive extraction of value through threats, force, exposure, or threatened harm.

name: Conflict-of-interest mechanism
description: Decision-making condition in which private interests overlap with entrusted duties and may distort impartial exercise of authority.

name: Rent seeking
description: Resource-allocation behavior aimed at obtaining income through control, privilege, or political restriction rather than productive exchange.

name: Clientelism
description: Political exchange system linking targeted benefits or access to support, loyalty, or reciprocal political obligations.

name: Procurement fraud
description: Manipulation or deception in purchasing processes to redirect contracts, prices, specifications, or payments.

name: Resource diversion
description: Mechanism through which resources intended for one system purpose are redirected to another actor or purpose.

name: Judicial corruption
description: Improper influence, inducement, coercion, or diversion affecting adjudication or judicial administration.

name: Electoral manipulation
description: Improper interference with electoral administration, access, counting, campaigning, or other components of a defined electoral process.

name: Abuse of office
description: Use of entrusted authority outside authorized purposes to obtain improper benefit or impose improper harm.

name: Coercive extraction
description: Systematic acquisition of labor, resources, or compliance through force, threat, or domination.

name: Information distortion
description: Systematic alteration, selective presentation, or fabrication of information affecting decision-making or accountability.

name: Institutional self-dealing
description: Use of institutional authority or resources to benefit the institution's controlling actors beyond authorized purposes.
